## F — Before You Drive
Research index: Before You Drive; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 24 and 17 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 39 through 43, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC04-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC04-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC04-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC04-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC04-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-STATISTICS — Verify dates and study context for survival multipliers, injury percentages, population fatality figures and belt-use prevalence before learner display.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-COLLISION-ILLUSTRATION — Verify assumptions behind the collision-speed/building-height illustration before presenting any equivalence.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-SHOULDER-FIT — Confirm current shoulder-belt fitting guidance before teaching the source’s fist-gap instruction.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-REAR-SEAT-LAW — Resolve broad rear-seat age instruction versus the later conditional age-and-weight rule using current authoritative Maine law.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-FORWARD-FACING — Verify age-two forward-facing transition against current child-restraint safety instructions and manufacturer limits.
VERIFY: ME-BEFORE-AGE-EIGHT-BOUNDARY — Resolve the exact-age-eight gap between the printed less-than-eight booster condition and more-than-eight belt condition.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
